name: Booking funnel
description: Spec §14.10: started, night, pax, table, details, rules, paid, confirmed, with drop-off.

parameters.name: Dataset
parameters.description: live = real clubs (analytics schema); demo = Velora only (analytics_demo schema)

cards.name: Attempts reaching each step
cards.sql: select step_no, step, sum(attempts)::int as attempts from (select * from (select club_id, started_on, step_no, step, attempts from analytics.booking_funnel where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, started_on, step_no, step, attempts from analytics_demo.booking_funnel where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by started_on) f group by step_no, step order by step_no

cards.name: Funnel by club and start day
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, started_on, step_no, step, attempts from analytics.booking_funnel where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, started_on, step_no, step, attempts from analytics_demo.booking_funnel where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, started_on, step_no
